prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 员工花名册 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "工号" · longest unbreakable word 59px · one-line width 59px
  col 2: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 70px
  col 3: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 87px
  col 4: header "职级" · longest unbreakable word 21px · one-line width 35px
  col 5: header "入职日期" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 94px
  col 6: header "主要职责" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 555px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 503px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 502px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"供读者查阅员工身份、所属部门、职级、入职日期和主要职责。","reading":"读者可先按工号或姓名定位员工，再横向读取其部门、职级、日期和职责；也可纵向比较部门、职级和入职日期。职责较长，预计会决定多数行的高度，其他字段的适度换行可利用这些行高。","groups":["工号与姓名共同标识员工。","部门与职级共同描述员工的组织位置。","入职日期是便于纵向比较的时间字段。","主要职责是解释员工工作内容的长文本字段。"],"keep_intact":["工号应保持完整单行。","职级应保持完整单行。","入职日期宜保持完整单行，方便比较。","姓名应尽可能保持完整，避免在姓名中间断行。"],"may_wrap":["主要职责可按中文语义自然换行。","部门名称可在必要时换行，并利用职责文本形成的行高。","空间紧张时姓名可换行，但应尽量避免。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [80, 65, 83, 42, 115, 117] · table 503×711px · row heights [66, 197, 66, 145, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [80, 56, 57, 42, 115, 152] · table 503×632px · row heights [66, 145, 92, 118, 118, 92] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [80, 82, 100, 42, 115, 83] · table 503×1054px · row heights [66, 303, 92, 250, 276, 66] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"工号和入职日期保持单行，便于定位和纵向比较；部门大多只分两行，职责表头完整。","problems":"职级表头竖向断开，多个姓名也在中间换行；职责栏文字较密，长职责形成很高的行，其他栏留下大片空白。","cause":"职级栏42px只留21px文字宽度；姓名栏65px不足以容纳较长姓名；职责栏117px限制了长文本的行宽。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"职责栏较宽，长职责更容易连续阅读，整表的行高也比r0A更均衡；工号和日期仍保持单行。","problems":"部门名称普遍被切成三行，姓名也频繁断开，影响从身份到组织位置的横向阅读；职级表头仍竖向断开。","cause":"部门栏57px和姓名栏56px过窄，职级栏42px不足以容纳两个汉字的表头；节省的宽度主要给了152px的职责栏。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"姓名和部门比其他方案更完整，身份与组织信息较容易扫描；工号和日期保持单行。","problems":"职责被挤成极窄的文字柱，长记录占据大量行，行内空白失衡；职级和主要职责表头都换行，姓名仍有一处断开。","cause":"职责栏仅83px，文字空间只有62px；职级栏42px不足以容纳表头，而姓名栏82px仍不足以容纳最长姓名。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[80,73,73,55,115,106],"change":"给职级表头55px以保持单行，姓名和部门各留73px以容纳常见的三字内容；职责栏106px仍可换行，换取身份和组织信息更易扫描。"},{"name":"duty-priority","widths":[80,73,57,55,115,122],"change":"在职级表头和多数姓名保持完整的前提下，把部门栏缩至57px，让职责栏达到122px；利用职责形成的行高容纳部门换行。"},{"name":"intact-names","widths":[80,91,57,55,115,104],"change":"姓名栏91px可容纳最长姓名，工号、职级表头和日期也保持单行；部门和职责承担更多换行，适合以人员定位为主的查阅。"}]}
